name: Tantei Bokumetsu
source:
"Yatsuzakikou" is a serial killer who has killed more than 100 people and thrown the country into chaos.

To put an end to his murder spree, the finest members of the "Detective Alliance", an organization made up of only the top detectives, launch a joint investigation. Its members have a wide range of unique personalities, like the "Armored Detective" clad in armor, the "Literary Detective" with an excellent memory and love for books, "Netherworld Detective” who specializes in the occult, and many more.

Around the same time, an ordinary boys' high school student named Wato Houjou, who longs to become a detective, arrives at a remote island where the Detective Alliance is headquartered under the guidance of a mysterious man named "The Sage Detective".

On the island, Wato could not hide his excitement at meeting the Detective Alliance he so admired. However, when the detectives suspected him to be Yatsuzakikou, he was at a loss for words. To clear his name, Wato and the Detective Alliance leader, the "Ideal Detective", launch an investigation.

14 detectives remain alive. And Yatsuzakikou is among them...

A detective simulation adventure game in which 14 detectives confront a serial killer. During the game, investigation parts in which the detectives investigate will occur. However, the player’s avatar, the Incompetent Detective, does not have a special skill. So the key is for the player to give detailed instructions to their reliable detective colleagues and have them carry out the investigation on your behalf.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/02/tantei-bokumetsu-opening-movie-first-details-and-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
连环杀手“八裂公”已经杀害超过100人，让整个国家陷入混乱。

为了终结他的杀戮，由顶尖侦探组成的组织“侦探同盟”，选出了最精锐的成员，展开联合调查。成员们个性鲜明，有身披铠甲的“武装侦探”、记忆力出众且热爱读书的“文学侦探”，还有专攻神秘学的“魔界侦探”等等。

与此同时，憧憬着成为侦探的普通高中男生北条和都，在神秘男子“老师侦探”的引导下，来到位于偏远孤岛上的侦探同盟总部。

见到一直仰慕的侦探同盟，和都难掩兴奋。可当侦探们怀疑他就是八裂公时，他顿时说不出话来。为了洗清嫌疑，和都与侦探同盟的领袖“理想侦探”，一同展开调查。

仍然活着的侦探，共有14人。而八裂公，就在他们之中……

一款14名侦探与连环杀手对决的侦探模拟冒险游戏。游戏中设有侦探们展开调查的搜查环节，然而，玩家的分身“无能侦探”并没有特殊技能。因此，向值得信赖的侦探同伴下达详细指示，请他们代为搜查，便是游戏的关键。

[编译自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/02/tantei-bokumetsu-opening-movie-first-details-and-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
